rationale: RDDT is down ~22.65% on a post-earnings gap with extremely elevated relative volume (11.24x), trading near the session low at 6.3% of today's range — classic post-earnings capitulation territory where direction is highly uncertain. The price is just 0.74% above the session low of $91.30, suggesting potential support but also risk of a flush through it; meanwhile the broader market is under significant pressure (SPY -1.56%, VIXY +9.60%), which adds downside risk to any long.
